children: said on Wednesday its budget brand Sinsay would launch a marketplace for third-party sellers to diversify revenue streams and scale its business.
The platform will focus on categories that complement Sinsay's fashion offering, such as cosmetics, toys and home goods, with an aim to offer more than 100,000 products by 2027.
Sinsay will operate a closed marketplace, verifying and adding external partners that meet its quality and delivery standards.
The initiative creates a new revenue source for LPP without relying solely on its own inventory.
The retailer plans to expand the new marketplace to its first foreign market in 2027.
The marketplace will be integrated with Sinsay's physical store network, allowing shoppers to use stores to pick up orders.
LPP has been pursuing international expansion through Sinsay while investing in technology, including AI.
